remarks: Experience the vibrant lifestyle of South Norwalk in this modern studio condominium at 134 Washington St #D209, offering 474 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. Built in 1985, this unit features an open floor plan that maximizes space and functionality. The well-appointed kitchen boasts contemporary appliances and ample storage, seamlessly flowing into the living area, which is bathed in natural light from large windows. The sleeping area provides a cozy retreat, and the bathroom is equipped with modern fixtures. Residents enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry and access to building amenities such as secure entry and dedicated parking. Located in the heart of SoNo, you're steps away from eclectic dining, boutique shopping, art galleries, and the scenic waterfront. Commuters will appreciate the proximity to the South Norwalk train station and major highways, making this an ideal home for those seeking both comfort and convenience in a bustling urban setting.
